reviewNotes: HOLD. Vodafone Egypt currently documents foreigner prepaid KYC and free prepaid roaming activation from day one, but no current generic prepaid number-deactivation/recycling or minimum keep-alive lifecycle was located. The tempting Park Your Line service is explicitly postpaid-only and cannot be used as prepaid retention evidence. Vodafone Tourist Line is a separate visitor product and is not merged into this generic prepaid route.

events.outcome: Vodafone Egypt prepaid foreigner KYC and prepaid roaming are current, but Park Your Line is explicitly a postpaid service and Tourist Line is a separate visitor product; neither establishes generic prepaid long-term number retention.

data.acquisitionSummary: Vodafone Egypt prepaid remains a current product. For foreign customers, Vodafone lists a valid passport plus valid residency/refugee residency, exemption or e-visa among required documents. A separate Tourist Line is sold at airport and retail stores for visitors; it is not treated as the same long-term prepaid lifecycle.

keep.action: No current generic prepaid line-deactivation/recycling or minimum keep-alive rule was located. Vodafone's Park Your Line offers 1–12 months for EGP10–120, but Vodafone explicitly classifies that service as postpaid-only; it must not be used for this prepaid route.

data.chinaActivation: Initial foreigner identity verification/acquisition is Egypt-based; overseas-first activation is not established.
data.kyc: Vodafone's current document page requires foreign prepaid customers to provide a valid passport plus valid residency/refugee residency, exemption or e-visa. Tourist Line is a separate visitor product.
data.payment: Vodafone roaming guidance says prepaid/Control/Easy users should maintain sufficient credit and can top up with a registered credit card while roaming; exact foreign-card onboarding acceptance is not established.
data.roamingSms: Vodafone states prepaid/Control/Easy lines can activate roaming free from day one. Current guidance confirms roaming connectivity and notification SMS, but China-specific OTP reliability was not independently reproduced.
data.holdReason: Current prepaid identity and roaming rules are documented, but final prepaid number lifecycle/minimum retention cost remains unresolved. Park Your Line is postpaid-only and Tourist Line is a separate visitor product, so neither may be used to manufacture a prepaid keep-alive claim.

guideSteps: Keep Tourist Line separate from generic Vodafone Egypt prepaid.
